patch_description: Add a low-cost deterministic contact-escape stage after the existing elite polishing. The highest-scoring jammed arrangements can be trapped by a rigid contact graph even when a nearby unequal-radius arrangement is better. This refinement slightly deflates each of the two best certified candidates, perturbs only circles with substantial clearance from every wall, and reruns short high-accuracy SLSQP solves. Restricting motion to interior circles preserves the useful square-adapted boundary layer while allowing alternative bulk tangencies and asymmetric radius allocations to emerge. Every result is still ranked by the existing common-scale certification procedure.
